title: Moving pieces
style: cinematic horror film still, buzzing fluorescent-lit storage unit corridors and a cramped city apartment at night, an eerily detailed handmade dollhouse, dust in the air, sickly green and warm tungsten tones, dramatic moody lighting, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 3. A tiny figure moves through the dollhouse every night. So does something in Gina's apartment. 🪆

Original fiction. Part 4 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: the dollhouse matched Gina's apartment down to last night's dishes, and someone had slept in the tiny bed.
scenes.image: miniature dollhouse bed with a dented pillow and blankets turned down

scenes.narration: On the third night, she finds it behind the tiny fridge. A figure, no bigger than her thumb. Carved wood. A long grey coat. And no face. Just smooth, pale grain.
scenes.image: close-up of a small carved wooden figure in a grey coat with a blank smooth faceless head, held between two fingers

scenes.narration: She stands it in the tiny kitchen. In the morning, it's on the tiny couch. Facing the tiny window.
scenes.image: tiny faceless wooden figure sitting on a miniature grey couch inside a dollhouse living room

scenes.narration: She props her phone up to film it all night. Eight hours of nothing. It never moves on camera. But by morning, it's somewhere new.
scenes.image: phone propped on a stack of books facing a dollhouse in a dark apartment, a small red recording light

scenes.narration: And her real apartment has changed too. A dent in the couch cushion. A kitchen chair pulled out. Her bedroom door, which she shut, standing open.
scenes.image: dim apartment living room in morning light, a kitchen chair pulled out at an angle, a dent in a grey couch

scenes.narration: Wherever the little figure goes in the dollhouse, something goes in her home.
scenes.image: split composition of a tiny figure standing in a dollhouse hallway and the matching real hallway, empty and dark

scenes.narration: So she moves the dollhouse into her bedroom. She wants to see it coming.
scenes.image: woman dragging a large dollhouse into a small bedroom at night, lamp light, tense expression

scenes.narration: Night four. She doesn't sleep. She sits up in bed with the lamp on, watching the dollhouse in the corner.
scenes.image: woman sitting up in bed hugging her knees, staring at a dollhouse in the corner of the dim room

scenes.narration: At three in the morning, she blinks. The tiny figure is in the tiny bedroom. At the foot of the tiny bed.
scenes.image: faceless carved figure standing at the foot of a miniature bed inside a dollhouse bedroom

scenes.narration: And at the end of her real bed, the mattress slowly sinks. Like something heavy has just sat down.
scenes.image: foot of a bed in a dark bedroom, the blanket pressing down into a deep dent with nothing visible on it
